A local macOS workspace for projects, tasks, journals, and coding agents.

## Download

- **Apple Silicon (M-series):** `MontyBrain-macos-arm64.zip`
- **Intel:** `MontyBrain-macos-x64.zip`

Each ZIP contains the desktop app, its matching MCP server, agent skills, and `INSTALL.md`. Move `MontyBrain.app` to Applications. Follow `INSTALL.md` for optional agent setup without compiling from source.

The app interface and command language are currently in Polish. Documentation and the website are in English. Builds are not Apple Developer signed or notarized; macOS may block the first launch. See [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/open-a-mac-app-from-an-unknown-developer-mh40616/mac).

SHA-256 checksum files are attached alongside the downloads. Your vault remains separate from the app and is not replaced by an update.
